notes: amp now plays music from other disks: a second partition, a USB drive or a network share. Those tracks used to stay silent because macOS only let amp load files from the disk the app was on (#2, thanks QinisoM and alpha-wave). Built on tinyjs 0.70.2.

win.notes: amp now plays music from other disks: a second partition, a USB drive or a network share. Those tracks used to stay silent because macOS only let amp load files from the disk the app was on (#2, thanks QinisoM and alpha-wave). Built on tinyjs 0.70.2.

linux.notes: Built on tinyjs 0.62.0. This release is all Ballroom (faster, four new styles, ↑/↓ leaf), which needs WebGPU; Linux's WebKitGTK doesn't have it yet, so Ballroom stays hidden here.
